newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt to meet majority parties over DPEF plan.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt to meet majority parties over DPEF plan.

text.p: Italy's government will hold a meeting with leaders of majority parties to discuss its economic plan (DPEF) as a matter of routine before the document is presented to parliament, Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco said.
Visco told reporters that the document of economic targets for 1998-2000 will also be presented to trades unions and the Confindustria employers body before its official approval.
Hard-left Communist Refoundation leader Fausto Bertinotti earlier called for a meeting of majority parties before the cabinet approved the document.
The DPEF will now go before the cabinet early next week intead of later this week as originally planned.
Visco said the delay was due to Prime Minister Romano Prodi's planned engagements abroad.
By law, the DPEF should be presented to parliament by May 15 each year following cabinet approval.
